name: fix-hoh1-lobby
about: Issue #123 (the Dark Citadel's last floors were four Dark Halls floors: hoh1.content was off by default). hoh1.content is now on by default and the host checks every player's HoH1 import (HWP::HoH1, a fingerprint build.py writes): HoH1 floors, the HoH1 tower and HoH1 pets play only when every player's matches; otherwise the Dark Citadel goes dark_halls_1 -> Avatar, the portal offers the HoH2 tower, HoH1 pets are put away, and every player is told in red. One lab game stands in for the lobby with `hwp hoh1 fake none|other|match|silent`: a second player with no import, another import, the same one, or one that never reports. Checks the default-on verdict and chain, the pet put away and back, one join warning per mismatch, the short chain and the portal fallback, dark_halls_1 -> boss_avatar with a warning on each, the 'differs' and 'no report' warnings, and the chain back on a match. No StartLoadServer hoh1/. Solo forced state: a real two-player lobby is not covered. About 5 minutes.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:campaign\] self-check done: mission ok, \d+/\d+ schemes, HoH1 floors installed,
steps.name: campaign self-check: the import is packed and on by default
default on; the HoH1 pet put away and back; a peer without the import: one warning, short chain, HoH2 portal
Dark Citadel with that peer: dark_halls_1 then the Avatar, warned on both
another import, no report, then the same import: the warnings and the chain back
no level loaded from hoh1/ during the run
